input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on us. Section 12.3 affirmatively confirms that nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or operating in any field or territory, and that we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. The only competitive restraint (12.4) binds Vendor for our benefit, and the licence restrictions in 13.4 are ordinary use/anti-reverse-engineering limits, not restraints on our business. This meets the preferred position; no redline required.
